comments.text: Adversarial migration review: invariants checked across adapter payload -> Jido incoming/event -> bridge -> Engine capture/admission -> exact authorized transcript -> model context -> Executor/Factory -> durable finalization -> HistorySync completion -> warm runtime. Tests prove root appears once, untrusted inline text is absent, duplicate capture is stable, cross-room/connector references do not leak, membership+manual revocation denies history, missing roots do not fetch or traverse siblings, parent attachments retain their authorized placement, ordinary delivery remains in the chat and explicit native quoted sends remain intact. No production correctness blocker found in this migration. Oversized native thread IDs are bounded to 255 UTF-8 bytes to fit existing persisted identifiers, with boundary tests. Existing metadata remains readable but ignored. Native live WhatsApp and multi-node execution were not exercised. Release gate remains zaq-s67.5: published reviewed adapter revision must replace current lock before merge; local linked source is only the validation environment. Full ZAQ coverage process still running; MCP client connection expired at 300s while actual subprocess remains within the 600s task limit. Do not use coverage report until actual successful completion is confirmed.

Actual full coverage command completed successfully despite the MCP client disconnect: 547.7s test runtime, 11379 tests + 282 properties + 48 doctests, zero failures, one existing skip/125 excluded; full project 97.0%. The original wrapper creates /tmp/zaq-s67-coverup.log only in the return-code-zero branch; that file and a fresh exported JSON confirm actual success. Successful full JSON preserved at /tmp/zaq-s67-full-coverage-success.json; lib source hashes preserved. All modified production lines covered. All touched ZAQ production files >=95% except RequestControl 94.66% (missed 63,73,215,229,271-273). Coverage-upper delegated one additive public-boundary security test for line 63 to assigned test-file owner; no production edits or existing assertion changes. Other coverup entries belong to unrelated pre-existing PR scope and are not changed by this migration.

Full captured log /tmp/zaq-s67-precommit.log and actual result /tmp/zaq-s67-precommit-status.json. Final mix q passed. Adapter mix quality and full serial non-live coverage passed: 196 tests + 12 properties, zero failures, 84.9%, all changed executable production lines covered. ZAQ fresh full coverage passed at 97.0%; additive selector regression is included in final passing gate. Review report /tmp/zaq-s67-review.txt. No remaining proven production correctness findings. Explicit sibling path dependency is the approved local-review setup and supersedes the original no-path-overlay validation criterion; publication and validation against a fetchable reviewed revision remain in zaq-s67.5.
